Info

Defines ScaraBounds domain value object for kinematic limits.

class scaralang.core.model.kinematics.profile.bounds.ScaraBounds(*, links: LinkDimensions, vertical: VerticalBounds, speeds: SpeedLimits, joints: JointAngleBounds, singularity: SingularityMargins)[source]¶

Bases: object

Domain Value Object encapsulating kinematic geometry and operational limits for SCARA arm.

It defines:

attributes:
links - Mechanical link lengths (L1, L2) in mm.
vertical - Vertical motion limits (Z min, Z max) in mm.
speeds - Operational velocity and acceleration limits.
joints - Joint angular limits for shoulder and elbow.
singularity - Singularity thresholds and deadzone margins.
